race.comment: GRAND IMPACT (2) is a reliable gelding who maps well third up after two strong efforts. His job has been made a lot easier with the Eagle coming out. Expecting to Lloyd to land handy and prove mighty tough to hold out late. MONTE KATE (11) gets in light and has enough early pace to offset the wide alley and run them along, which could make her very pesky. Chance to steal it. ROMEO'S CHOICE (3) went amiss last start but her two prior runs here are a much better guide, and from a softer draw she's worth keeping safe. COSMIC FIRE (4) comes through two strong QLD runs and should be at his top now. Can play a role.
